seo.metaDescription: Explore our enterprise delivery approach: align business outcomes, govern quality and security, and choose commercial models that fit your requirements.
seo.keywords: delivery approach, governance, Cyber-Safe Delivery, commercial models, enterprise delivery approach, technology delivery governance, IT project delivery approach, software delivery assurance, managed services engagement models, outcome-based IT services

sections.title: Our delivery approach
sections.subtitle: Agree the value, govern delivery and measure the result across technology, data, security and talent.

sections.heading: Start with the outcome you need
sections.body: We begin with your business requirements, the people affected and the result that would make the investment worthwhile. The same value framework applies across all five portfolios: strategise and govern, accelerate and deliver, then measure and optimise.
sections.secondaryBody: Our [strategic solutions](/solutions) connect customer triggers with relevant portfolios, Linkfields software and reusable IP. Delivery is adapted to your [industry context](/industries), constraints and operating model.

sections.heading: From strategy to *measurable business value*

items.title: Strategise & govern
items.description: Agree the real requirements, business baseline and constraints before prioritising work.
items.bullets:
Client decisions - priorities, success measures and risk appetite
Linkfields outputs - assessment, prioritised backlog and roadmap
Accountability - agree business sponsor and delivery lead
items.footText: Confirm scope, baseline, dependencies and decision owners before build.

items.title: Accelerate & deliver
items.description: Build and validate iteratively, using the software and accelerators that fit the requirement.
items.bullets:
Client decisions - review increments and approve changes
Linkfields outputs - working increments, test evidence and release plan
Accountability - agree technical, quality and security owners
items.footText: Review quality, security and business acceptance evidence before release.

items.title: Measure & optimise
items.description: Compare adoption and operational results with the baseline, then prioritise the next improvement.
items.bullets:
Client decisions - accept handover and improvement priorities
Linkfields outputs - benefit review and operating-model handover
Accountability - agree service owner and benefit owner
items.footText: Confirm operational readiness, ownership and the measures used for benefit review.

sections.description: Roles, review cadence and acceptance criteria are agreed for each engagement; they are not assumed from a standard template.

sections.heading: Quality and *Cyber-Safe Delivery*

items.title: Design and change readiness
items.description: Identify dependencies, data handling and security requirements before approving the design.
items.bullets:
Architecture and integration review
Risk assessment and control mapping
Agreed acceptance and test criteria

items.title: Build and release assurance
items.description: Connect test automation and security validation with the change and release process.
items.bullets:
Regression and integration evidence
Code and supply-chain analysis
Remediation and release decision record

items.title: Operational readiness
items.description: Make the handover decision visible: what is accepted, what remains open and who owns it.
items.bullets:
Runbooks and support responsibilities
Outstanding risks and agreed actions
Monitoring, adoption and benefit measures

sections.description: Cyber-Safe Delivery embeds security across engineering and delivery. The checks and evidence are selected for the scope and risk of the engagement.

sections.heading: Secure by design, *accountable throughout*

items.title: Decisions and escalation
items.description: Agree decision owners, review cadence, risk escalation and change control. Keep the delivery backlog, risk register and KPI reporting aligned.

items.title: Example acceptance evidence
items.description: An engagement can bring together a decision log, test results, security findings, remediation actions and sign-off records.
items.bullets:
Does the increment meet agreed acceptance criteria?
Have quality and security findings been addressed or accepted?
Are operating responsibilities and residual risks recorded?

sections.description: We agree the evidence and approval route with your team, tailoring this example engagement pattern to your scope, risk and contractual requirements.

sections.heading: Flexible *commercial models*

items.title: Fixed price
items.description: Defined scope and outcome delivered against agreed milestones and acceptance criteria.

items.title: Time & materials
items.description: Flexible delivery where scope evolves, with transparent rates and governance.

items.title: Managed service
items.description: Ongoing service with agreed SLAs, governance and continuous improvement.
items.footText: Application management, managed quality, managed security.

items.title: Dedicated team
items.description: Persistent squads or specialist teams aligned to your priorities and ways of working.
items.footText: Product engineering, sustained capacity, capability centres (GCC).

items.title: Outcome-based
items.description: Commercials linked to measurable business or operational outcomes, where these can be agreed and evidenced.

sections.description: What we agree together: scope, acceptance criteria, governance and measurement. Choose the commercial model that fits the work and the evidence available.
sections.note: [Linkfields products](/products-and-accelerators#how-to-buy) are available by licence, subscription or SaaS, with or without a Linkfields services engagement. Software scope and commercial terms are agreed separately.
